files.content:
# Pixel Task Timer

A simple offline task list with timers. Add tasks, start/stop individual timers (only one runs at a time), and remove tasks. Time is displayed in mm:ss format.

## Features
- Add tasks with a name.
- Each task has a Start/Stop button and a Remove button.
- Only one timer can run at a time; starting a new one stops the previous.
- Elapsed time shown as mm:ss.
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states.
- Responsive layout from 360px width.
- Pixel-inspired visual theme.

## Usage
1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Type a task name and click "Add Task" or press Enter.
3. Click "Start" to begin timing a task; click "Stop" to pause.
4. Click "Remove" to delete a task.

No server or network required. Works fully offline.

## Files
- `index.html` — main page structure.
- `styles.css` — styling and theme.
- `script.js` — application logic.

## Browser Support
Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari).

MIT
